title: Beet Greens and Kale with Bacon and Garlic
description: Beet greens and kale are sautéed with bacon and garlic in this simple side dish that prevents delicious beet tops from going to waste.
ingredients: 1 slice bacon, trimmed of fat and cut into small pieces
6 leaves beet greens, stems cut into 2-inch pieces
2 leaves kale, ribs and stems removed, chopped
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over low heat. Cook and stir bacon until browned and crisp, 3 to 5 minutes. Add garlic; cook and stir until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes.

Stir beet stems and kale into the skillet. Cover skillet and cook until kale wilts, about 3 minutes. Add beet greens. Cover and cook until bright green and wilted, 1 to 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
